assistant_required: Update the assistant before using this renamed extension's stored model or knowledge ownership. Existing settings are preserved.
node_required: Update this computer's node before changing the extension identity. Its existing data is preserved.
node_unreachable_one: Can't reach {machines}. Connect it, or remove it from this extension's computers, before changing the extension identity. Existing data is preserved.
node_unreachable_other: Can't reach {machines}. Connect them, or remove them from this extension's computers, before changing the extension identity. Existing data is preserved.
node_outdated: Update the node on {machines} before changing the extension identity. Existing data is preserved.
confirmation: This update changes the extension ID from {from} to {to}. Explicit confirmation is required; settings and data stay with the same installation.
